content:
I’ve been writing software since 2021, starting as an intern at TopOnTech, where I learned to break a problem down and picture every step before writing code.

Since then I’ve built backend systems across telecom, finance, and agriculture: internal tools at FPT Telecom, loan and partner APIs at VietCredit, and, at GreenFeed and later Excel Technologies, key parts of the systems that run daily operations at 32+ farms, from warehouse and sales to e-invoicing and SAP integration. Along the way I’ve also taken on freelance work, from e-commerce sites to Telegram bots that crunch data and run custom commands.

My sweet spot is the unglamorous stuff: SQL performance, clean APIs, security, and system integration. A favorite win: handling bulk inserts hundreds of times larger by passing XML lists straight into SQL Server stored procedures.

I mostly work in .NET with SQL Server and Postgres, pick up React when a feature needs to ship end to end, and lately I’m deep into AI-assisted development with Claude Code.

Off the keyboard: pull-ups, badminton, swimming, and black coffee somewhere green.

Open to freelance projects and backend roles. Got a messy problem? Let’s talk.
